Command docs for the impeccable workflow

Categories 6
Commands 24

Workflow map

Command overview

Create

Build something new, from a blank page to a working feature.

/impeccable Open command

Impeccable

Inteligenta de design din spatele fiecarei comenzi.

The design intelligence behind every command.
/impeccable craft Open command

Craft

Modelati designul, apoi construiti-l, totul intr-un singur flux.

Shape the design, then build it, all in one flow.
/impeccable shape Open command

Shape

Ganditi inainte sa construiti. Produseti un brief de design prin descoperire, nu prin ghicire.

Think before you build. Produce a design brief through discovery, not guesswork.

Evaluate

Review what you have. Score it, critique it, find what to fix.

/impeccable critique Open command

Critique

O revizuire de design cu scoruri, teste de persona si detectare automata.

A design review with scoring, persona tests, and automated detection.
/impeccable audit Open command

Audit

Verificare tehnica pe cinci dimensiuni cu severitate P0 pana la P3.

Five-dimension technical quality check with P0 to P3 severity.

Refine

Improve one dimension at a time: type, layout, color, motion.

/impeccable typeset Open command

Typeset

Reparati tipografia care pare generica, inconsistenta sau accidentala.

Fix typography that feels generic, inconsistent, or accidental.
/impeccable layout Open command

Layout

Reparati layout-ul, spatierea si ritmul vizual.

Fix layout, spacing, and visual rhythm.
/impeccable colorize Open command

Colorize

Adaugati culoare strategica interfețelor monocromatice fara a deveni stridente.

Add strategic color to monochrome interfaces without going garish.
/impeccable animate Open command

Animate

Miscare intentionata care transmite stare, nu decoratiune.

Purposeful motion that conveys state, not decoration.
/impeccable delight Open command

Delight

Mici momente de personalitate care transforma functionalul in memorabil.

Small moments of personality that turn functional into memorable.
/impeccable bolder Open command

Bolder

Impingeti designurile sigure catre impact fara a aluneca in haos.

Push safe designs toward impact without sliding into chaos.
/impeccable quieter Open command

Quieter

Reduceti designurile care striga fara a le pierde intentia.

Tone down designs that are shouting without losing their intent.
/impeccable overdrive Open command

Overdrive

Impingeti o interfata dincolo de limitele conventionale. Shadere, fizica, 60fps, tranzitii cinematice.

Push an interface past conventional limits. Shaders, physics, 60fps, cinematic transitions.

Simplify

Strip complexity. Remove what does not earn its place.

/impeccable distill Open command

Distill

Scadere necrutatoare. Reduceti designurile la esenta lor.

Ruthless subtraction. Strip designs to their essence.
/impeccable clarify Open command

Clarify

Rescrieti textul UX confuz astfel incat interfețele sa se explice singure.

Rewrite confusing UX copy so interfaces explain themselves.
/impeccable adapt Open command

Adapt

Faceti designurile sa functioneze pe ecrane, dispozitive si contexte diferite fara a amputa functionalitati.

Make designs work across screens, devices, and contexts without amputating features.

Harden

Make it production-ready. Edge cases, performance, polish.

/impeccable polish Open command

Polish

Trecerea finala meticuloasa intre bun si excelent.

The meticulous final pass between good and great.
/impeccable optimize Open command

Optimize

Diagnosticati si reparati performanta UI de la LCP pana la dimensiunea bundle-ului.

Diagnose and fix UI performance from LCP to bundle size.
/impeccable harden Open command

Harden

Faceti interfețele pregatite de productie. Cazuri limita, i18n, stari de eroare, depasire.

Make interfaces production-ready. Edge cases, i18n, error states, overflow.
/impeccable onboard Open command

Onboard

Desenati experiente de prima utilizare, stari goale si drumuri catre valoare.

Design first-run experiences, empty states, and paths to value.

System

Setup and tooling. Design system work, extraction, organization.

/impeccable teach Open command

Teach

Invatati Impeccable pentru cine este produsul dumneavoastra, o data per proiect.

Teach Impeccable who your product is for, once per project.
/impeccable document Open command

Document

Generati un DESIGN.md conform cu specificatia care capteaza sistemul vizual astfel incat fiecare agent AI ramane on-brand.

Generate a spec-compliant DESIGN.md that captures your visual system so every AI agent stays on-brand.
/impeccable extract Open command

Extract

Extrageti componente reutilizabile, token-uri si tipare in sistemul de design.

Pull reusable components, tokens, and patterns into the design system.
/impeccable live Open command

Live

Iterati pe UI in browser. Alegeti un element, adaugati un comentariu, primiti trei variante. Acceptati una si se scrie in sursa.

Iterate on UI in the browser. Pick an element, drop a comment, get three variants. Accept one and it writes to source.
